## Mathematical or code change

Describe the exact result/bug fix, parameters, and scope. If exploratory, mark it **CONJECTURED / UNVERIFIED**.

## Provenance (required for RH claims)

- [ ] Updated [claim provenance ledger](../research/audits/2026-10-07/RH_CLAIM_PROVENANCE_LEDGER.md) and existing [PROVENANCE_MAP](../PROVENANCE_MAP.md) if relevant.
- [ ] Recorded originating agent/user hypothesis, first proof commit SHA, prior work, and correcting commits.
- [ ] Named primary mathematical sources with URLs, **version numbers** and theorem/equation numbers.
- [ ] Distinguished original derivation from inherited classical results.
- [ ] Recorded exact test commands, environments, exit status and whether tests **actually ran**.
- [ ] Listed negative controls and counterexamples; ruled out tautological finite positivity.
- [ ] Marked all RH-equivalent but unproved inequalities and infinite-limit claims **UNVERIFIED**.

See [the full template](../docs/RESEARCH_PROVENANCE_TEMPLATE.md).

## Tests

Write the exact commands and results, or "NOT EXECUTED" with reason. Do not use numerical checks as proof of all-horizon estimates.

## Proof gate

Explain what this changes about the actual Suzuki/Weil positivity or Hardy-innerness obligation. If it changes nothing, state "**RH-inert structural identity**." RH remains open unless a complete, audited all-horizon proof is given.
